requirement.evidence: Landlords who rent any residential dwelling unit (defined as any primary residence excluding medical/long-term care or detention facilities) in the City of Hoboken are prohibited from price fixing using algorithmic pricing.
requirement.note: The definition of price fixing matches the card. Enforcement by the Division of Housing or an aggrieved private citizen in Municipal Court is also stated.

key_value.note: The fine and community service are supported. The card omits the third option, penalties under N.J.S.A. 40:49-5. The penalties are alternatives ('one or more of'), so the card's 'or' is acceptable but incomplete.

effective_date.evidence: This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon passage and publication as provided by law.
effective_date.note: The ordinance takes effect on passage and publication. Adoption on Jul 9, 2025 is documented, but the publication date is not stated. The card uses the adoption date, which is an approximation that its notes acknowledge.

status.note: The ordinance was adopted Jul 9, 2025 and takes effect immediately on passage and publication. No repeal or stay appears, so in_force as of 2026-10-01 is reasonable.

coverage.note: The coverage field is empty on the card.

citation.evidence: ORDINANCE AMENDING AND SUPPLEMENTING CHAPTER 158 (RENT INCREASES) OF THE HOBOKEN CITY CODE BY ADDING A NEW SECTION 158-2, ENTITLED “PROHIBITION AGAINST ALGORITHMIC RENT-FIXING IN THE RENTAL HOUSING MARKET”
citation.note: The title says § 158-2 but the body heading reads § 154-8. The card flags this discrepancy. The adoption date of Jul 9, 2025 is supported.
